title: Independently review the WP1 writing-method integration at accepted commit 0e371f8
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Independently review #554's WP1 integration against its pinned specification, original evidence and evaluation contract. Expected gain: a commit/tree-pinned Standards and Spec verdict, with reproducible evidence and concrete blocking findings or a scoped CLEAR for this preparation change only. No session can run LabVIEW.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Resolve candidate 0e371f8 to its full commit/tree using Git; compare with starting baseline 575d59ef8fcaf1f81a81d2eb605f52eb94053839, tree bd09e3a07e772337a3f045f69611b9f51dd3e227. Confirm these objects and scoped candidate bytes; distinguish parent integration commits from author evidence. Missing or mismatched inputs must be reported, not silently repinned.
- [ ] Check the exact repository delta against #554's permitted scope: five existing writing files (method.json, README.md, controls.json, verify_method.py, verification.json) plus integration-0112-provenance.json and .md. Check preservation of input-pins.json, review-corrections.json, historical proposal/checker/review, originals/licenses and preparation.json.
- [ ] Validate preserved #547 review SHA256 2dc007939a4b0637716027ef6e5a874702c9be7288daf80c3f007c07f382cdaf and its provenance; inspect the new integration addendum and output pins, acyclic hash design and actual recorded verification. Run the current read-only verifier; independently inspect whether it enforces the promised contract rather than relying on its passing result. Do not execute or refresh the frozen proposal checker against changed writing inputs.
- [ ] Review WP1's exact original, structural locator, text precondition 2 to 3 and one-byte allowance against the original and proposal. Check complete file-set preservation, no-op/wrong locator/value/precondition, unrelated byte/file edits, serialization/version changes and unsupported native/overall pass rejection. Use bounded independent in-memory or temporary-artifact probes for the changed integration, recording actual results. Preserve all existing synthetic task definitions and controls/reasons; check explicit inventory and reason enforcement. Do not replay #547/#541/#493 probes.
- [ ] Check W1-W8 mapping, WC1/WM1/WM2/WB1 preservation, W2 text-only eligibility, separate root-version declaration versus unavailable native save-version authority, qualified coverage and familiar-possible public development lineage. Audit prose and machine claims separately: hashes and structured controls cannot establish arbitrary narrative, semantic answers or native validity. Independent key approval, native keys/validation, matched arms/budgets/quota, isolation and owner method acceptance remain pending. No trials, native success, readiness or product approval may be inferred.
- [ ] Put separate Standards and Spec assessments, severity, precise file/line evidence, input commit/tree identities, commands and bounded actual outputs in .session/report.md and .session/artifacts/wp1-integration-review.json (plus optional focused probe artifacts). CLEAR is scoped to integration preparation only. Findings belong only to session outputs; edit no repository files. Include the exact artifact name and SHA256 for later preservation; do not require engine verification to read session outputs.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/verify_method.py
## Context
- Exported iteration 112 record: read .session/exports/manifest.json for its staged path and availability; task #554 is done, accepted and merged at 0e371f8 and its body is the integration specification.
- benchmark/writing/integration-0112-provenance.md: author evidence identifies starting baseline, seven allowed outputs, historical-checker invalidation and the need for this separate changed-tree review.
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and roles.md: independent review is preparation evidence; owner method acceptance remains necessary before product implementation.
## Budget
Read .session/exports/manifest.json then #554 body/outcome in its staged iteration 112 record selectively, skipping the duplicated input_state; benchmark/writing/{integration-0112-provenance.md,integration-0112-provenance.json,method.json,README.md,verify_method.py,controls.json,verification.json,input-pins.json,review-corrections.json}; benchmark/project-text-writing-0109.{md,json}; benchmark/project-text-writing-0109/review-0110-provenance.md and selected identities/findings from review-0110.json (not a whole large JSON dump); docs/perpetua/{evaluation.md,roles.md}. Read proposal-named preserved original/license and cited baseline/runner-contract.md or precision/README.md only for relevant obligations. Inspect Git diff and selected baseline versions of scoped writing files. Keep outputs short and probes focused; report early if pins fail. No repository-wide discovery, project reselection, POC investigation or historical probe replay. Parent commits accepted changes; engine verification has no .session artifacts or LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT. Save detailed review evidence by halfway through 80 turns.
